name: io.github.ggm1207/appflowy-mcp
description: MCP server for self-hosted AppFlowy Cloud — create, read, update, organize and search pages via the Cloud REST API.

environment_variables.name: APPFLOWY_BASE_URL
environment_variables.description: AppFlowy Cloud API base URL (e.g. http://localhost behind nginx, or http://localhost:8000).

environment_variables.name: APPFLOWY_GOTRUE_URL
environment_variables.description: GoTrue auth base URL (e.g. http://localhost/gotrue, or http://localhost:9999).

environment_variables.name: APPFLOWY_EMAIL
environment_variables.description: Account email used for the GoTrue password grant.

environment_variables.name: APPFLOWY_PASSWORD
environment_variables.description: Account password used for the GoTrue password grant.

environment_variables.name: APPFLOWY_WORKSPACE_ID
environment_variables.description: Optional default workspace id; defaults to the first workspace on the account.
